newsitem.title: USA: Watsco to buy privately held Coastal Supply.
newsitem.headline: Watsco to buy privately held Coastal Supply.

text.p: Watsco Inc said it agreed to buy Coastal Supply Co Inc, a privately held Savannah, Georgia-based wholesale distributor of parts and supplies used in heating and air conditioning systems, for an undisclosed amount.
Watsco said it expects the transaction to close within 60 days and to boost its 1997 earnings, although it did not specify by how much. Coastal had revenue of about $8 million in 1995, Watsco said.
Coastal's nine branches will expand Watsco's distribution network to 125 branches, Watsco added.
